data.gender_notes: Bhadraja is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhadr' meaning 'auspicious' or 'blessed'. The name Bhadraja is used to bless a child with good fortune and prosperity. The name Bhadraja carries the meaning “Blessed, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhadraja usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with blessings and positivity.
data.etymology: Bhadraja belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhadraja total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
